observations: Photo 0 and 1 show two different microwave ovens side by side, both doors open: one with a black exterior and black interior, another with a white exterior and black interior.
Both units carry a visible 'AKAI' brand logo (photo 1 on the white unit's control panel, photo 3 close-up on the black unit's control panel).
Photo 2 shows the black AKAI unit alone, from an angled, dim shot, resting on a counter; the top surface shows visible grime, dust, and dark stains.
Photo 3 is a close-up of the black unit's control panel: dials for Power (Low/M.Low/Med/M.High/High/Combi.1-3/Grill), Timer(min), and Defrost(kg). No model number or serial plate is visible.
No power cord being plugged in, no display lit, no turntable spinning, and no clip of the unit heating food is shown.
Door hinge and seal areas are visible but no close-up of rust, cracks, or mesh damage is provided beyond what's in the wide shots.
